Jon (AE): Passing Catalyst into CS — signed today, $200k ARR, 12-mo term. Key deliverables: SSO (Okta), on-prem connector for data-sandbox, dedicated capacity for pilot (2x A10G) starting Jan 15. Renewal in Nov 2026 — potential risk if pilot slips. TL;DR: need kickoff + SSO cert + infra contact.

Maria (CSM): Thanks @Jon — I'll own the onboarding. @Sam (Onboarding) can you schedule kickoff? Adding a success plan draft link: https://redwood.internal/docs/catalyst-success (will update after kickoff).

Sam (Onboarding): Can do. Proposed times: Thu Jan 4 10am PT or Mon Jan 8 2pm PT. Need customer's network engineer contact and IdP metadata (Okta). Who's their technical lead?

Jon (AE): Their lead is Tara Nguyen (tara@catalyst.ai) — I cc'd her on the contract email. I'll drop IdP metadata + PO into the shared drive by EOD.

Lee - Support: FYI we'll need VPN + test S3 creds and a permission matrix for the on-prem connector. Please open a support intake ticket with env details and expected pilot volume. Use this template: 

``nTicket: catalyst-pilot-0001
Environment: staging
Owner: lee_support
Pilot window: Jan15-29
Expected TPS: 0.2-0.6 req/s per instance
SSO IdP: Okta (metadata attached)
``

ops-bot: Created and linked support ticket #CT-4123 — https://support.redwood/CT-4123 :white_check_mark:

Maria (CSM): Owner / next steps summary: 
- Jon (AE): share IdP metadata + billing PO in this thread (@Jon (AE))
- Maria (CSM): send kickoff invite + success plan draft
- Sam (Onboarding): prepare pre-kickoff checklist and runbook
- Lee - Support: create infra playbook + monitoring dashboard
- Eng Ops: review capacity config for 2x A10G and burst policy

Maria (CSM): Risk note — if we don't have IdP metadata by Jan 3, we should shift pilot and flag renewal risk. Please ack owners.

Tara (Customer): Thanks team, I can provide Okta metadata by EOD tomorrow and schedule a network call with our infra lead.

Maria (CSM): Ack — I'll create a tracking doc and post updates here. :rocket:
